title: You Can’t Outrun These Cops In a High Speed Chase
description:
On August 11, 2021, police attempted a traffic stop on a 44-year-old man in Marshfield, WI. After an hour-long chase, the man eventually crashed his vehicle after spike strips were deployed and a pursuit intervention technique was performed.
